dedupe_keys.name: fao aquastat main database country water statistics including municipal wastewater and irrigation water use

description: AQUASTAT is FAO's global information system on water and agriculture; FAO produced its main database of country water statistics with a special emphasis on irrigation and agricultural water. Its wastewater category, built with IWMI from the end of 2013, holds annual national volumes of municipal wastewater produced, collected, treated, discharged and used directly for irrigation, the number of treatment facilities and the area irrigated with wastewater: about 2,300 data points and 1,300 metadata as of October 2016. An irrigation water use review added modelled irrigation water requirement and estimated withdrawal for 165 countries and 2 territories. Coverage is global at country level. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): FAO terms: statistical databases fall under the FAO Open Data Licensing Policy and Statistical Databases Terms of Use (licence of this database not named on the pages read). Caveats: data come from many sources and can be inconsistent over time, wastewater information is not available for all countries, and some gaps are filled by modelling. Simulation uses: national demand, withdrawal and wastewater volumes for planning and drought scenarios. Related records: AQUASTAT georeferenced dams (data-fao-aquastat-georeferenced-dams) and the global map of irrigation areas (data-fao-global-map-of-irrigation-areas).
